# Logic Pac

> Logic Pac is a custom packaging development partner for beauty, cosmetic, and consumer brands. Structural design, global sourcing, holiday gift set manufacturing, influencer kit production, jewelry packaging, and fulfillment. Backed by Logic Agency Inc. with 20+ years of supply chain operations across 15+ countries. Based in Orange County, CA and Salt Lake City, UT.

Logic Pac is the packaging arm of Logic Agency Inc. Every project runs through structural engineering, global sourcing, quality control, retailer compliance, and (when needed) US-based kitting and fulfillment. Typical minimums start at 50 units for PR kits and 500-1,000 units for custom retail packaging. Timelines range from 6-10 weeks for standard programs to 5-7 months for holiday gift sets.

## Capabilities

- [Overview of Capabilities](https://logic-pac.com/capabilities): Structural design, global sourcing, quality control, compliance, kitting, and fulfillment.
- [Holiday Gift Set Packaging](https://logic-pac.com/holiday): Custom rigid boxes, advent calendars, multi-component kits, kitting, and retail compliance for Ulta, Sephora, and Target.
- [Influencer Kit & PR Mailer Production](https://logic-pac.com/influencer): Custom kits designed for unboxing, 50 to 5,000+ units, with direct-to-recipient fulfillment.
- [Custom Jewelry Packaging](https://logic-pac.com/jewelry): Rigid jewelry boxes, branded inserts, holiday gift sets, and coordinated brand systems across all box sizes.
- [Portfolio and Case Studies](https://logic-pac.com/work): Filterable portfolio of holiday kits, influencer/PR programs, beauty and cosmetics packaging, retail packaging, specialty finishes, and jewelry packaging.

- [Beauty Refillable Playbook](https://logic-pac.com/guides/beauty-refillable-playbook): Economics and material combinations for refillable packaging systems at scale.
